citation: Schubert MM, et al. Physiol Rep 2024;12:e15968
protocol: 1 h cycling at ventilatory threshold the evening before a meal test (exercise condition); exercise VO2, percentage of VT, RER, HR and lactate in the exercise-response table, printed for non-users and cannabis users
population: 11 non-users (5 M) and 11 cannabis users (6 M), healthy active adults, 25.4 +/- 5.1 and 28.9 +/- 7.2 y
note: Read the non-user column as the healthy group; bout is the evening before a test meal; dose is VO2 at ventilatory threshold.
